USING TRIPTO

Terms that stay human

These terms describe the agreement for using Tripto. They are written to make the important parts easy to find.

Last updated 16 September 2026
tripto.to
Using the service
Use Tripto only for lawful travel planning and trips you are entitled to manage.
Keep your sign-in method and device secure.
Do not attempt to disrupt the service, access another person’s data, or bypass security controls.
Your content

You keep ownership of the information you add. You give Tripto only the permission needed to store, process, display and synchronise that information for you and the people you explicitly invite to a shared trip.

Travel details need a final check

Tripto helps organise information from bookings and confirmations. Always verify dates, times, ticket conditions, gates and provider requirements directly with the airline, hotel or other travel provider before you travel.

Tripto Plus

Plus purchases are processed by Lemon Squeezy. A paid subscriber can manage or cancel their subscription through the secure billing portal linked from Account. Cancellation stops future renewal according to the terms shown at checkout; it does not retroactively refund a completed billing period unless the provider’s checkout terms say otherwise.

Availability and changes

Tripto is provided on an “as available” basis. We may improve, change or retire features. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss arising from use of the service.

Data sources

Offline city data includes GeoNames under CC BY 4.0. Airport identity data comes from OurAirports (Public Domain) and common airport data includes mwgg/Airports under the MIT License.

Still need help?

Write to us with the minimum information needed to understand your request.

Email go@tripto.to
